summary_1line: Vidula fiercely rebukes her defeated son Sanjaya, urging him to abandon cowardice, reclaim Kshatriya honor, and wage war to restore their kingdom and dignity.

image_candidates.scene_text: Queen Vidula stands before her dejected son Sanjaya, fiercely rebuking him in a dim palace chamber stripped of royal splendor.
Vidula, once adorned in jewels, imagines herself and her daughter-in-law weakened by hunger while abandoned servants depart from their empty palace.
A warrior king in shining armor proclaims his name on the battlefield while charging into enemy ranks under raised banners.
